text:
**Overall T03 verdict: FAIL.** The latest candidate records the raw-output failure case and classifies Codex’s footer correctly. It also recovers locks whose owner is confirmed dead. Two reproduced defects still violate T-2. A review can overwrite another project’s call ledger, and a conflicting timestamp can silently change an existing attempt.

I verified the working-tree candidate based on `2719c36dbcf506d888279b8e408bafd6b3f9250f` using Node v24.22.3 on macOS arm64.

| Criterion | Outcome | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| T-1 | Pass | Project and backlog CLI input used the same v1 schema as automatic calls. Fixtures preserved request and observation sources, distinguished reported zero from `null`/`unknown`, and stored a scope-relative result reference. |
| T-2 | **Fail** | Idempotent replay, enrichment in both orders, parallel writes, dead-owner recovery, and malformed-input rejection passed. A conflicting `at` value was accepted, and `verify --out` destroyed an existing ledger in another scope. |
| T-3 | Pass | The bounded fixtures covered p, ACP, chain, and verify. Raw-output errors preserved completed attempts. Timeout and cancellation produced interrupted rows. Verify fallback produced two rows and linked the successful row to its review record with matching duration and token counts. Skip, preflight rejection, issuance, and budget blocking left the attempt count unchanged. |
| T-4 | Pass for verified cases | Stats reported known sums and unknown counts and counted a mirrored worktree attempt once. In an adopted representative-task fixture, `bd77aa2` and the candidate returned identical stats with the call ledger present or absent after removing the candidate’s `agentCalls` section and normalizing `observed_at`. Event, review-ledger, and team metrics matched. The unadopted fixture left team metrics absent. The full close and retrospective workflow was outside the runtime checks. |

### Remaining defects

1. **`agent verify --out` can overwrite another project’s ledger.** In a temporary repo, I populated `P001/calls/log.jsonl` with four rows, then ran `node "$PACE_BIN" agent verify --target "$P002_ARTIFACT" --author-agent claude --purpose "synthetic fixture" --out "$P001_LEDGER"`. Exit was **0**. P002 gained one valid call row, but P001’s four rows were replaced with the review result. `project stats P001 --json` then reported `agentCalls.state: "unreadable"`. The output guard checks only the reviewed target’s call directory. [Output guard](/tmp/pace-p014-t03-final.j2oQTn/tester/src/agent/verify-cli.ts:56) · [Output write](/tmp/pace-p014-t03-final.j2oQTn/tester/src/agent/verify-cli.ts:491)
2. **Reusing an ID with a different timestamp silently backdates the row.** I copied an automatic P001 row into a PM input file, changed only `at` to `2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`, and ran `node "$PACE_BIN" project log P001 --type agent_call --call-file "$INPUT_JSON" --json`. Exit was **0**, the ledger stayed at four rows, and the existing attempt’s 2026 timestamp changed to 2020. The merge picks the earlier timestamp. [Merge logic](/tmp/pace-p014-t03-final.j2oQTn/tester/src/project/agent-calls.ts:106)

### Comparison with phase 1

- **Raw output fixed.** The same `--raw-dir` regular-file reproduction gave **1 launch, 1 completed row, exit 1**, with measured input `0` and output `23`. The control without `--raw-dir` gave one additional row and exit **0**. The bounded suite also confirmed the ACP case.
- **Codex footer fixed in the call ledger and stats.** A footer of `123` gave **1 Codex row, exit 0**, with total `123` and input and output unknown. The existing review-ledger usage field retains its legacy mapping.
- **Lock handling improved.** A lock carrying a confirmed-dead PID was removed and the next call added one row. The empty-lock reproduction still gave **1 launch, 0 added rows, exit 0**, with a warning and unchanged ledger bytes. Retaining an unverifiable lock matches the contract’s fail-closed behavior.

### Commands and counts

```sh
PACE_HOME=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pace-t03-suite.XXXXXX) node --test --test-concurrency=3 test/agent-calls.test.ts test/agent-acp.test.ts test/agent-p.test.ts test/agent-chain.test.ts test/agent-review-log.test.ts
```

Exit **0**. **106 tests, 105 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped, 0 cancelled, 0 todo** in 31,381.994791 ms. The skip was Windows-only. Phase 1 reported 57 passes.

```sh
PACE_HOME=$(mktemp -d /tmp/pace-t03-scope.XXXXXX) node --test --test-name-pattern='^허가 범위: (작업본·실제 index·중간 커밋에 범위 밖 변경이 남으면 진행하지 않는다|최신 원본과 대조해 여러 줄의 작은 수정만 진행하고 다음 검토에 보존한다|verify가 Git 기준을 고정하고 잘못된 경로·보호 줄은 pass를 만들지 않는다)$' test/project-harness.test.ts
```

Exit **0**. **3 tests, 3 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled, 0 todo** in 19,171.860583 ms.

The CLI reproductions used local stubs. One diagnostic command briefly created a synthetic row in the isolated candidate checkout. I removed that row and its new directory and confirmed Git status matched the starting state. Candidate source and tests were unchanged. The full suite, live providers, and Windows were outside this verification.
